Jardim will be without Plata, who is suspended following his third yellow card. Lucas Paquetá (left knee issue), Alex Sandro (left thigh injury) and Danilo (recovering from jaw surgery) are expected to miss out.

Head-to-head record

Flamengo and Grêmio have met 127 times in history. The Rubro-Negro have 45 wins to Grêmio's 42, with 40 draws between the sides. The pair have found perfect balance in goals too—159 scored each. [...] Flamengo v Grêmio: Team news and match information

# Flamengo v Grêmio: Team news and match information

Rubro-Negro face Grêmio on Wednesday evening at the Maracanã as they bid to extend their lead atop the Campeonato Brasileiro

ByRomulo Paranhoson 11/04/2026 at 12:25

Share

759493-TREINO NO NINHO - 03-11-2026 FOTO ADRIANO FONTES_FLAMENGO_54.jpg

Adriano Fontes / CRF [...] Flamengo return to action on Wednesday, November 4, to face Grêmio at the Maracanã at 7.30pm BRT for matchday 34 of the Campeonato Brasileiro. The league leaders are seeking another victory against the Rio Grande do Sul outfit to extend their advantage at the top of the table and edge closer to championship glory.
